resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts entry sits under a Jackson County heading, but the same page's index lists Hamaker Butte under Douglas County; the 2023 USGS-based map listing and the TopoZone entry also place it in Douglas County, which matches the record.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one short Forest Lookouts entry plus two map pages. No build date, design, staffing or fate in any source found. The Forest Lookouts page's 'Jackson County' heading conflicts with the Douglas County map listings; the record's Douglas County is kept. The firelookout.org Oregon list has no Hamaker Butte entry, so no FFLOS or NHLR status was found. Pastmaps places the butte on the Umpqua and Rogue River NF boundary, while the lookout page lists only Rogue River NF; the editor may want to check land ownership before any visit note. Two web searches used; neither found a second lookout-specific source.
